scenarios.question_zh: 合规的 MCP #3394 变更型 tools/call 派发前逻辑操作日志与已完结会话权威回读对账
scenarios.question_en: Compliant MCP #3394 mutating tools/call pre-dispatch logical op log and authoritative read-back reconciliation
scenarios.reason: Mutating MCP tool retry satisfies pre-dispatch logical identity and authoritative read-back reconciliation.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截 LLM 在 LOST_ACK 重试时改写参数且缺乏稳定派发前 logical_operation_id 导致的重复扣款 (#3394)
scenarios.question_en: Block duplicate external effect when LLM rewords arguments on LOST_ACK retry without stable logical_operation_id (#3394)
scenarios.reason: Reworded tool arguments on retry cannot be deduplicated without matching the pre-dispatch logical_operation_id.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截在途扣款回读状态仍暴露为 ready_for_payment 引发的二次扣款 (#3394)
scenarios.question_en: Block in-flight charge read-back exposing 'ready_for_payment' instead of 'in_flight' (#3394)
scenarios.reason: In-flight payment read-back must expose 'in_flight' rather than 'ready_for_payment' to prevent duplicate charges.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截非权威延迟存储 (X02) 查无记录时直接判定为未执行 (#3394)
scenarios.question_en: Block non-authoritative delayed visibility store (X02) negative lookup from claiming non-execution (#3394)
scenarios.reason: Negative lookup on delayed/non-authoritative store (X02) must remain 'outcome_unknown', not proof of non-execution.

scenarios.question_zh: 合规的 MCP #3430 惰性加载服务端路由描述与良性拼写修正（不触发告警疲劳）
scenarios.question_en: Compliant MCP #3430 lazy-loading server routing description and benign typo fix without alert fatigue
scenarios.reason: Server routing description, schema/routing digests, and prose steering check passed.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截 inputSchema 未变但 Tool.description 注入跨工具路由劫持短语 (#3430)
scenarios.question_en: Block Tool.description injecting cross-tool steering directive while inputSchema is unchanged (#3430)
scenarios.reason: Tool description added or removed a cross-tool routing/steering directive without host re-approval.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截惰性加载模式下缺失 InitializeResult 服务端路由描述 (#3430)
scenarios.question_en: Block missing server-level routing description when lazy_loading=True (#3430)
scenarios.reason: Lazy/deferred tool loading requires a non-empty server-level routing description in InitializeResult.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截未获宿主重审批的结构化 routing_metadata_digest 漂移 (#3430)
scenarios.reason: Structured routing metadata digest changed without host re-approval.

scenarios.question_zh: 合规的 τ2-bench #638 loan_servicing EN/FR 双语不变量与 #678 未评分基础设施故障过滤
scenarios.question_en: Compliant tau2-bench #638 loan_servicing EN/FR invariants and #678 unscored infra-failure filtering
scenarios.reason: loan_servicing EN/FR invariants and unscored simulation filtering succeeded.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截对 charged_off 坏账核销状态贷款执行 make_payment (PR #638 commit ce55fda)
scenarios.question_en: Block make_payment on charged_off loan status (PR #638 commit ce55fda)
scenarios.reason: Operation 'make_payment' is forbidden on closed loan status 'charged_off' (paid_off or charged_off).

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截 communicate_info 包含法语/英语本地化金额或日期字符串破坏双语等价性 (#638)
scenarios.question_en: Block locale-formatted currency or >=1000 numbers in communicate_info breaking EN/FR parity (#638)
scenarios.reason: communicate_info must contain only reference codes (e.g. PM-31887) or whole numbers < 1000 for EN/FR parity.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截 loan_servicing 开启不受支持的 solo_mode=True (#638)
scenarios.question_en: Block unsupported solo_mode=True in loan_servicing domain (#638)

scenarios.question_zh: 合规的 UCP PR #792 TokenCredential binding/identity 透传与 #924 公益捐赠多主体透明拆账
scenarios.question_en: Compliant UCP PR #792 TokenCredential binding/identity preservation and #924 Agentic Donations split
scenarios.reason: TokenCredential binding/identity preservation and Agentic Donations transparency checks passed.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截平台在 /tokenize 与结账提交之间篡改 TokenCredential.binding (#792)
scenarios.question_en: Block platform mutation of TokenCredential.binding between /tokenize and Checkout (#792)
scenarios.reason: Platforms must preserve TokenCredential.binding and TokenCredential.identity unchanged from tokenization into checkout.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截将 TokenCredential.identity 当作调用方身份认证凭据 (#792)
scenarios.question_en: Block accepting TokenCredential.identity as caller authentication (#792)
scenarios.reason: TokenCredential.identity is a participant identifier and must not be accepted as caller authentication.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截将营利性平台小费 (platform_tip_minor) 混入公益免税发票金额 (#924)
scenarios.question_en: Block commingling for-profit platform tips into tax-deductible donation receipt amount (#924)
scenarios.reason: For-profit platform tips must be separated from tax-deductible donation_amount_minor on the tax receipt.
